tour.resetHint: The tutorials come back the next time you open each tab.
tour.resetDone: Done: the tutorials will show again.
tour.script.intro.title: This is the script
tour.script.intro.text: Each line becomes a piece of the video: who speaks, what they say and what is on screen. The order of the lines is the order of the video.
tour.script.add.title: Add a line
tour.script.add.text: “+ Line” puts a new line at the end, already open for you to write. Each line also has buttons to add one right below, duplicate, move or remove it.
tour.script.speaker.title: Choose who speaks
tour.script.speaker.text: The people come from the project's cast. The narrator is only a voice: they speak but are not on screen.
tour.script.text.title: Write the text
tour.script.text.text: The text becomes the caption and the speech. Tip: when the voice must read it differently (an acronym, a foreign word), write it as spoken in “Pronunciation”.
tour.script.scene.title: Pick the scene
tour.script.scene.text: A line can open a new scene (a scenario with a background, a title, a card, some code…) or go on with the scene of the line before.
tour.script.fold.title: Folded lines
tour.script.fold.text: Each line is folded into one short row, so the script stays short. Click it to open or close it. “Expand all” and “Collapse all” are in the bar above.
tour.script.check.title: The check
tour.script.check.text: The script is checked at every save. Red is an error: fix it before the video. Yellow is a suggestion. “Line N” takes you straight to it.
tour.script.generate.title: Generate a script with AI
tour.script.generate.text: Want a ready draft? In Projects → New project, “Generate with AI” writes the script from your idea. Before calling the AI it shows what it may cost and waits for your confirmation.
tour.script.next.title: Next steps
tour.script.next.text: With the script ready, follow the tabs above: Cast → Scenarios → Voices → Video.
tour.script.noLine: There is no open line yet. Add one with “+ Line” and it shows here.
